message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and Deploy Snapshot
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
jobs:
  build-and-deploy-snapshot:
    name: Build and Deploy Snapshot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'spring-io/spring-javaformat' }}
    steps:
    - name: Check Out
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set Up
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup
    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
    - name: Build
      run: ./mvnw clean deploy --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --update-snapshots -DaltDeploymentRepository=distribution::file://$(pwd)/distribution-repository
    - name: Deploy
      uses: spring-io/artifactory-deploy-action@v0.0.1
      with:
        folder: 'distribution-repository'
        uri: 'https://repo.spring.io'
        repository: 'libs-snapshot-local'
        build-name: spring-javaformat
        username: ${{ secrets.ARTIFACTORY_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.ARTIFACTORY_PASSWORD }}
        signing-key: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        signing-passphrase: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Maven multi-module project (pom.xml files and ./mvnw build) with repeated successful pushes to main, so dependency fetching is repeated across runs. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) is supported by literature evidence (observational, modest aggregate benefit: free 6%, paid 3.4% VM time reduction) and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable from the CI history, and cache inputs can include the dependency manifest (pom.xml) plus runner OS. Adding a standard actions/cache step for ~/.m2/repository keyed by hashFiles('**/pom.xml') preserves every existing build, test, and deploy step and all required checks/secrets unchanged; it only avoids re-downloading unchanged dependencies. No permissions are weakened, no new secrets or deployment/publishing operations are added, and no new network access beyond the existing cache service is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

The CI history shows runs taking about 8-12 minutes (created 18:29, updated 18:37:56 = ~9 min; 17:41:42 to 17:53:44 = ~12 min). But there's no explicit timeout currently. Adding a timeout could help. But the evidence example shows timeout-minutes: 5 which seems too aggressive for a Maven build. The experiment example showed 26.8% savings but that was a Node lint workflow.
